name: namespace-delete-known-miss
why: no longer a gap (formerly a KNOWN MISS): a user deletes the whole namespace to destroy its Events. The namespace controller then deletecollections the Events as system:serviceaccount:kube-system:namespace-controller, which filter_namespace_teardown removes, and this namespace delete is not an Events delete, so this rule correctly does not match it. The hunting rule k8s_namespace_deleted.yml matches this same record (its positive namespace-delete-payments), so the actor's own request is covered there
source: synthetic: kubectl delete namespace payments, Metadata (the teardown sweep that follows is case namespace-teardown-deletecollection-core)
